findings.title: Gizli planın içinden çıkan karşı-bilgi
findings.claim: 12:15'te kardeşlerin Yusuf'u görünmez kılmak üzere kesinleştirdiği eylem, aynı gizli alan üzerinden Yusuf'a ulaşan iletiyle daha sonra onların fiilini haber verecek bir karşı-bilgi düzenine dönüşür.
findings.mechanism: 12:15:4:2'deki kesin tutum, 12:15:8:1'deki görünmezlik ve çukur yer, 12:15:10:2'deki gizli ileti ve 12:15:12:2'deki gelecekte haber verme aynı olay örgüsünde temas eder. 12:102 toplu kararı gizli haber olarak geri çağırır; 12:19 kuyunun sakladığı kişiyi görünür bir taşıma zincirine çıkarır; böylece gizleme eylemi gelecekte açığa çıkarılabilir bir işe bağlanır.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur kuyuyu yalnızca yok etme yeri olarak değil, görünmez kılma ile bilginin korunmasının kesiştiği ve kararın gelecekte rapora döndüğü bir eşik olarak görür.
findings.containment: Fiziksel kuyunun ve kardeşlerin fiilinin düz anlamı korunur. Kardeşlerin vahyi amaçladığı, kuyunun yalnızca mecazi bir epistemik oda olduğu veya gelecekteki haberin 12:15'te zaten gerçekleştiği ileri sürülmez.

epistemic.reason: Trusted cross-run finding all five focus branches supplies; legacy reader-walk records and direct connection rows reinforce the reversal. Target ayat have exact Arabic but no target morphology, and the counter-disclosure synthesis remains an interpretation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Düşünme ve hazırlığın ardından bir işi yapma yönünde kesin tutum alınır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus Form IV verb أَجْمَعُوا carries the brothers' completed collective resolve with a content clause.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 12:102 connection revisits the brothers while they had أَجْمَعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ and were plotting, making the hidden collective decision a later reportable object.
branch_activations.activation: The completed resolve meets a later divine account of the same concealed gathering, so the decision is heard as an act whose secrecy does not prevent its future disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The brothers' firm decision becomes the first side of a concealed plan that already carries the possibility of counter-report.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is collective resolve in the supplied content clause; no claim is made that the verb itself means concealment or that the later account is uttered inside 12:15.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gözden, duyudan ya da bilgiden uzak kalma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey gözle görülmez, duyuyla algılanmaz veya insan tarafından bilinmez durumda kalır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus construct noun غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ carries a hidden recess and the loss of ordinary visibility.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 12:102 connection pairs أَنْبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ with the brothers' concealed gathering, returning hiddenness as knowledge supplied by revelation.
branch_activations.activation: The physical recess meets a later unseen-news frame, changing concealment from mere disappearance into a condition in which the hidden event remains available to disclosed knowledge.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pit hides Yusuf from the plotters' intended view while the event is preserved for a future counter-disclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not establish that every hidden thing is known to humans or that the pit is only an epistemic metaphor; the later unseen-news relation is contextual.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yer çevresine göre alçak veya çukurdur ve içine giren şeyi gözden saklar.
branch_activations.carrier: The definite well/pit expression supplies a concrete low place that hides Yusuf from the brothers' view.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 12:19 connection shows travelers discovering and drawing Yusuf out of the well, giving the hidden place a separate retrieval and transfer event.
branch_activations.activation: The well's concealment function meets its later discovery, so the place reads as a temporary interface between attempted disappearance and an unintended route into continued history.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pit hides the intended victim without guaranteeing the plot's final disappearance; concealment itself becomes the condition through which the future can continue.
branch_activations.boundary: The well remains a physical well and the brothers' destructive purpose remains intact; no rescue, safety, or benevolent intention is imported into the focus scene.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir olay veya durum hakkında başkasına ulaşan bilgi içerikli haber söz konusudur.
branch_activations.carrier: The emphatic future Form II verb تُنَبِّئَنَّهُمْ is a promised act of informing the brothers about their own affair.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 12:89-90 connections show Yusuf asking about what they did to him, then identifying himself after their recognition, supplying the later report and the changed speaker-recipient relation.
branch_activations.activation: The future report meets the later confrontation and recognition, changing the brothers from controllers of a hidden event into recipients of information about their own deed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threatened victim becomes the informed narrator of the plotters' act, and the act of hiding carries its own promised disclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus promises informing but does not itself narrate the later dialogue; no claim is made that the report exhausts the whole later recognition scene.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bilgiyi ya da sözü gizlice iletme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bilgi veya söz bir başkasına gizlilik koşulu altında ulaştırılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus Form IV verb أَوْحَيْنَا carries hidden, directed communication from God to Yusuf during separation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 12:102 connection explicitly joins hidden news to نُوحِيهِ, showing that the concealed event is conveyed through a directed disclosure rather than ordinary observation.
branch_activations.activation: The hidden communication meets the brothers' hidden plan and preserves knowledge on Yusuf's side, so secrecy becomes the medium of a counter-plan rather than a guarantee of ignorance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The divine message installs future knowledge inside the concealment scene while the plotters remain unaware of its significance.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch supports concealed directed communication, not a public announcement, human foresight, or a claim that the brothers consciously participate in the revelation.

findings.title: Haberin muhatabından anlatıcısına
findings.claim: Gelecekteki bildirme vaadi, Yusuf'u planın nesnesi olmaktan çıkarıp kardeşlerinin fiilini onlara bildirecek özne konumuna taşır; böylece tanıma ve anlatı yetkisi yer değiştirir.
findings.mechanism: 12:15:12:2'deki haber verme fiili, 12:15:17:1'de kardeşlerin süren fark edememe hâliyle aynı cümlede kurulmuştur. 12:58'de kardeşlerin Yusuf'un karşısına gelmesi, 12:89-90'da ise Yusuf'un onların fiilini sorup kimliğini açıklaması, hareketin ve bilginin yönünü tersine çeviren bağımsız temas noktalarıdır.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, tehdidin yalnızca Yusuf'un saklanması olmadığını; sonunda saklanan olay hakkında konuşma ve tanınma yetkisinin de fail gruptan mağdura geçtiğini görür.
findings.containment: Düz anlamdaki gelecekte haber verme vaadi korunur. 12:15'te kardeşlerin Yusuf'u tanıdığı, sonraki sahnenin tek mümkün gerçekleşme olduğu veya نَبَأَ kökünün hareket anlamının haber anlamını sildiği ileri sürülmez.

epistemic.reason: The trusted cross-run record supplies the core relation, and legacy reader-walk records supply its later fulfillment and wide-context movement. Target Arabic is exact but target morphology is absent, so the authority-transfer synthesis remains qualified.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bir yerden başka bir yere geçip belirme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlık bir yerden ayrılarak ya da gelerek başka bir yerde bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The n-b-ʾ branch is present on the exact focus carrier, where reporting also carries the possibility of information arriving to recipients.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 12:58 connection supplies the brothers' later arrival before Yusuf and the changed recognition positions.
branch_activations.activation: The report carrier meets a later movement into Yusuf's presence, so the promised news is heard alongside a reversal in who appears, recognizes, and is recognized.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The one concealed from the brothers becomes the one before whom they arrive, while the narrative's knowledge travels in the opposite direction from their earlier plan.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual movement resonance around the n-b-ʾ carrier; it does not redefine the focus verb as a motion verb or import all movement scenes into its lexical meaning.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir olay veya durum hakkında başkasına ulaşan bilgi içerikli haber söz konusudur.
branch_activations.carrier: The emphatic future report verb gives Yusuf the promised role of informing the brothers about their own affair.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 12:89-90 connections show the later question about their deed and Yusuf's recognition disclosure, where the threatened person controls the account of what happened.
branch_activations.activation: The promised report meets its later confrontation, changing the intended object of concealment into the speaker who makes the concealed deed knowable to its authors.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus contains a transfer of narrative authority: the plotters' act becomes the victim's report to them.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation is a qualified later relation, not a claim that the full 12:89-90 dialogue is already present in the focus wording.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: dikkatle fark edip bilme ve bunu sağlayan duyular
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi dikkatle fark edip algılayarak bilmek temel anlamı oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The negated imperfect يَشْعُرُونَ carries the brothers' ongoing failure to perceive or recognize what is happening.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 12:58 and 12:90 connections show the later recognition reversal: Yusuf recognizes them first, while they initially fail to recognize him and then identify him through his disclosure.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's negated perception meets the later recognition scene, making their unawareness part of the same reversal that gives Yusuf the report-authority promised earlier.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their failure to perceive includes failure to understand that the person they dispossess will become the one who tells them what they did.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is limited to the supplied perception and recognition relation; it does not claim a single uninterrupted psychological state across all later verses.

findings.title: Gizli yerleştirme içinde korunan gelecek
findings.claim: 12:15'teki Yusuf'u belirli bir konuma getirme fiili, başka bir ayette tehlikedeki çocuğun gizli yönlendirmeyle taşınıp gelecekte geri döndürülmesi ve görevlendirilmesiyle birlikte duyulabilir kılar; böylece yerleştirme, kardeşlerin görünen amacını korurken tek sonucu yok oluş olmayan bir gelecek yönü kazanır.
findings.mechanism: 12:15:6:1'deki جَعَلَ taşıma ve konum değiştirme ilişkisi, 12:15:10:2'deki ilahi bildirimin yönlendirilmiş iletişim ilişkisiyle temas eder. 28:7'deki وَأَوْحَيْنَا ... فَأَلْقِيهِ ... إِنَّا رَادُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ bağlantısı, tehdit altındaki bir çocuğun gizli yönlendirme ve gelecek vaadiyle yer değiştirmesine bağımsız bir bağlam sağlar.
findings.reader_payoff: Kuyuya bırakma eylemi, kardeşlerin yok etme niyetiyle sınırlı kalmadan, ilahi bildirimin sahnede görünmeyen bir gelecek yönü taşıdığı bir yer değiştirme olarak okunabilir.
findings.containment: 28:7 paralel bir bağlamdır; Yusuf'un kuyuya bırakılmasını Musa'nın suya bırakılmasıyla özdeşleştirmez, kardeşlerin fiilini hayırlı ya da ilahi yönlendirmeyle eşdeğer kılmaz ve geri dönüş veya peygamberlik sonucunu 12:15'in lafzına taşımaz.

epistemic.reason: The exact 12:15 carriers and the authored conn_7b2f56d735f25f25d864 connection supply a concrete cross-context parallel, but the target connection lacks target morphology and no trusted candidate publication nominated this branch; the finding is therefore qualified and independently grounded rather than attributed to a candidate.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: birini veya şeyi belirli bir duruma getirme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Var olan bir katılımcının durumunu, niteliğini veya konumunu değiştiren ettirici işlemi bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus causative placement verb يَجْعَلُوهُ takes Yusuf as its object and assigns him a new locative situation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 28:7 connection pairs hidden divine direction with casting an endangered child away and promising both return and a changed future role.
branch_activations.activation: The focus placement relation meets a separate placement-under-revelation scene, so location change becomes legible as an act whose visible human purpose does not exhaust its future trajectory.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Yusuf's placement in the pit remains an act of disposal in the brothers' plan but also stands at a point from which an unseen future can continue.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch concerns a change of location or condition, not rescue or appointment in 12:15; the parallel does not erase the brothers' agency or their harmful intent.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bildirimin kaynağı Tanrı, alıcısı ise seçilmiş bir kuldur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus revelation verb أَوْحَيْنَا identifies God as the communicating source and Yusuf as the recipient during separation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 28:7 connection supplies another divine communication to a threatened child that directs hidden removal while promising a future return and role.
branch_activations.activation: The focus revelation meets a parallel divine instruction in a threatened-removal scene, making the unseen communication an active source of future orientation rather than mere concealed information.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The message to Yusuf gives the hidden placement a divine future horizon while leaving the brothers unaware of that horizon.
branch_activations.boundary: The comparison does not claim identical recipients, identical outcomes, or that Yusuf's revelation is a public prophetic commission at this point.
